title: pagination helper returns wrong pages
prompt: Bug report: pager.paginate(items, page, per_page) returns wrong pages (first page is skipped, the last partial page is lost, and a per_page of 0 crashes with the wrong error). Fix pager.py so it follows its docstring exactly: page is 1-based, pages = ceil(total / per_page) but at least 1 (an empty list has one empty page), an out-of-range page is clamped into [1, pages], per_page < 1 raises ValueError, and the result dict has items, page (the clamped page), per_page, total, pages, has_next, has_prev. Visible tests: run `python3 -m unittest -q` in the repository root.
